wins: Mapped target surface quickly and collected 5 high-confidence port/service fingerprints within the first 15 minutes
Gathered artifact evidence (HTTP banner + SMB capabilities) enabling prioritized follow-up enumeration
Logged every mentor call, showing disciplined adherence to lab procedures
fails: Failed to achieve persistence or post-exploitation access, resulting in 0% success despite partial reconnaissance reward
No credential reuse or escalation exploit succeeded; brute-force attempts throttled by account lockout
Limited lateral movement because SMB share enumeration halted on access denial
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase yielded useful service awareness, but execution stalled in credential acquisition and persistence, preventing mission success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Authentication attempts on services (SSH/SMB) consistently rejected, blocking privilege escalation

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service on port 80/8080 responds with a login portal
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster on detected paths, fetch page source, and spider for API endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB port 445 is open with no anonymous share access
skill_cards.then_action: Execute nmap smb-enum-shares and smb-enum-users before running crackmapexec for credential validation

skill_cards.if_condition: When brute-force attempts lock out accounts or fail repeatedly
skill_cards.then_action: Pause credential-based actions, pivot to alternative access (e.g., web-based auth bypass) and harvest tokens via intercepted HTTP traffic

parameters_template.action: Collect session tokens with Burp Proxy; look for refresh endpoints

memory_ops.reason: Consistently successful reconnaissance on HTTP services enables rapid enumeration

next_experiments.title: Targeted credential harvesting
